# Subway Seat for Zed

All three flavors in one theme family: copy the theme file, or install the dist/zed folder of a clone with Zed › Extensions › Install Dev Extension. The title and status bars sit darkest, panels a step lighter, the editor lighter again, and menus and popovers are raised above it. Selections, search matches and diffs use the same colors as the other editor ports, and the agent panel's diffs follow them.

[Zed](https://zed.dev) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/zed/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`themes/subway-seat.json`](themes/subway-seat.json) | `~/.config/zed/themes/subway-seat.json`; Windows: %APPDATA%\Zed\themes |
| All three | [`extension.toml`](extension.toml) | part of the dev extension: Zed › Extensions › Install Dev Extension, then pick this folder |
| All three | [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) | part of the dev extension: Zed › Extensions › Install Dev Extension, then pick this folder |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in settings.json:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in settings.json:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat Tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in settings.json:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat Enamel"
```

## Follow light and dark

In settings.json:

```json
"theme": {
  "mode": "system",
  "light": "Subway Seat Enamel",
  "dark": "Subway Seat"
}
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/zed/themes/subway-seat.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
